I can't confirm that for the full period. The assessment status is "insufficient evidence."

**What the data shows:** FIRMS returned zero thermal detections intersecting ASSET-F14 (2026-10-13 to 2026-11-12) in the days that were covered. MODIS, VIIRS NOAA-20 and VIIRS NOAA-21 cover the whole period. VIIRS S-NPP covers it except for one gap.

**The gap:** VIIRS S-NPP has no data from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06, because the FIRMS area API did not provide those days. Under the stated rule, every sensor must cover every day to count as fully covered, so the full-period claim fails.

**Caveats:** Even in covered days, zero detections does not prove no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The data also says nothing about burned area or about anything outside this period.

A fair statement is: "No detections in covered days, with a five-day S-NPP gap." The other three sensors do cover those days.
